observations: Photo shows a keyboard/synth-style instrument with many keys on the left and a control panel with buttons/ports and a small display on the right.
A label on the front panel appears to read 'PSR-550' (partially visible).
There is visible wear/dust and some scuffing on the control area and speaker grille.

claims.evidence: No power-on/playing video or screen-lit test in the provided photo; only the instrument is shown.

risks.risk: Whether it truly works (power, speakers, keys, and buttons) — photos can’t confirm functionality.
risks.proof: Short video: power on, show display lighting, play a few notes across the keyboard, and demonstrate at least one button/feature (e.g., rhythm/voice) with audio.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified (assume possible faults) until a working test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables) affecting usability.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (adapter/pedal/cables) plus a close-up of the charging/power port.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming buyer may need to source missing accessories.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (scratches, loose knobs, damaged speaker grille) that may affect long-term reliability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: speaker area, all knobs/buttons, and the keyboard keybed (especially any uneven keys).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for cosmetic wear and potential minor damage.

proof_requests: Video proof: power on + display on + play keys (left-to-right) + show at least one function working with sound.
Photos of included accessories (power adapter/pedal/cables) and close-up of the power/charging port.
Close-ups of speaker grille and the control panel (knobs/buttons) to confirm nothing is loose or damaged.
response.reason: The model appears to be a Yamaha PSR-550 from the front label, but the seller’s 'working perfectly' claim is not verifiable from a single photo. Request a quick power-on and playing test before pricing confidently.
